name: Kroell
description:
## Description

"This is the first integrated amplifier in the Kroell, inheriting the in the development of high-grade separate amplifiers such as KAS and old power balance amplifiers.The power amplifier uses 12specially made metal-can-type power transistors jointly developed with Motorola. Stable current supplying capability is obtained by operating Pc250W class power transistors in 3parallel / full complimentary service configuration.The stages of the preamplifier are fully discrete / full complimentary service. All circuits from the first stage of the line input to the previous stage of the output stage are pure class A, and sound quality is enhanced by our unique ultra-low NFB and ultra-wide band design.The preamp section is fed by a dedicated constant voltage regulator, which is completely independent of the output stage, to eliminate adverse effects on the reproduced sound due to mutual interference.The volume control uses a 152step analog volume by applying a multiplexing DAC element.The volume is attenuated by switching the high-precision R2R ladder resistor built into the DAC, so that transients and phase changes that are unavoidable with a normal variable resistor are small, and a low-colorization sound is realized at any volume position.The minimum step interval is 0.2dB and can be controlled from the remote control.The power supply section contains a large toroidal transformer with a large capacity of 400VA and a computer-grade filter condenser.It is equipped with one XLR balance system and single end Route 3input terminals. It is equipped with one tape loop system and preamplifier terminals which can be used for multi-amplifier, etc.One single-ended input can also be switched to the theater throughput for connecting a surround processor, and if the K300i is built into a home theater system, it can be used as a single processor for volume control and other operations.The source selector is provided by a highly reliable, completely sealed relay located at the shortest distance from the terminal panel to eliminate the routing of signal lines inside the enclosure, and the relay itself is controlled by the control voltage of the system control section, which is electrically and spatially independent of the signal path.The internal layout uses dual monaural construction.It comes with a wireless remote control of aluminum block carving.This remote controller is black anodized and lettering is toreutics processed. It provides centralized control not only for all functions including power ON/OFF, but also for other remote-controlled Kroell products such as power amplifiers."

name: KAV-400XI
description:
## Description

"An integrated amplifier developed as a successor to the KAV 300il.All stages, including volume circuits, are composed of fully balanced circuits of full discrete complimentary service.The power amplifier uses 8Pc80W silicon-epitaxial planar LAPTs per channel. This LAPT is a composite device in which 59small-signal bipolar transistors are generated on a single pellet. It has excellent overall characteristics including dynamic characteristics. It combines high slew rate and high power by utilizing the design philosophy of Kroell current-mode design up to the output stage.The power supply consists of a 750VA large-capacity toroidal transformer and a 55,000Ï‰ F capacitor.The preamp section uses the full-discrete / full-output configuration for all stages, which is also used in Kroell single preamp. All circuits from the line input group to the pre-stage of the complimentary service stage are pure class A. In addition, our unique ultra-low NFB and ultra-wide band design allows for wide-range sources such as SACD.The preamp section is fed by a dedicated constant voltage regulator, which is completely independent from the output stage, so that interference does not adversely affect the playback sound.The volume control is equipped with a fully balanced analog volume that switches the R-2R resistance of the multiplexing DAC element in 152steps using a rotary optical encoder. This method has minimal transients and phase changes, and produces low-colorization sound at any volume position.The step interval is at least 0.2dB for delicate adjustment.It is equipped with a switching function to theater throughput that fixes the preamplifier gain of any input terminal to 0dB.This makes it possible to integrate volume control on the surround processor when it is connected to a home theater.The terminal panel uses a double-contact, highly reliable, completely sealed relay, which is located at the shortest distance to shorten the signal path.Internal signal interference is reduced by small-size integrated electronic components and latest surface mounting technology of Kroell.The front panel is used to integrate the function control and other microcomputer components, keeping a large spatial distance from the amplifier. In addition, the transformer winding is completely separated from the dedicated power supply to minimize interference between the control and amplifier circuits.Wireless remote control is included.There are 2color variations of silver and black."

name: KAV-500I
description:
## Description

"This pre-main amplifier has been announced as the highest integrated amplifier model with further scale-up based on the K300i.A Pc250W class Motorola original power transistor is used for the output stage.The preamplifier section has a full discrete / complimentary service configuration and uses a pure class A system.A direct coupling configuration is adopted between the output of the preamp section and the input of the power amplifier, which is directly connected by the current mode.This enables lossless transmission and fresh signal amplification that cannot be obtained with general voltage mode transmission.A 2-kVA class power supply with a large toroidal transformer is used for the power supply.The power supply circuit uses dedicated toroidal power transformers for the preamp and power amplifier respectively. The complete separation configuration eliminates the interference between stages.Fully balanced analog volume is used for the volume part.This volume is an evolution of the analog volume of the R2R ladder resistor device used in the K300i. The left and right channels are fully balanced with independent hot and cold channels, and the volume is adjusted by an electrically isolated optical rotary encoder isolated optical rotary encoder that simultaneously switches four pairs of resistor taps.This configuration prevents noise generation, degradation of transient / phase characteristics, and sound quality change due to attenuation, which cannot be avoided structurally with a normal variable resistor.Equipped with a theater throughput function, the gain of the power amplifier is fixed for a specific input system, and it can be adjusted collectively from external devices such as a processor.Built-in pre-out terminal for parallel output.Trigger input / output / RC-5terminal for remote operation is mounted.Wireless remote control is included."

name: KRC
description:
## Description

"Line control amplifier pursuing high bias pure class A low-impedance configuration.The KRC achieves a maximum output of 28v with an output impedance of 4�.The line amplifier section employs a balanced method for all stages to ensure high S/N and to eliminate external influences.The input stage uses FET to avoid the influence of source impedance variation on sound quality, and the output stage uses bipolar elements suitable for high current in order to realize a low-impedance configuration with high driving force for full complimentary service pure class A operation.All signal paths are direct coupled, eliminating the colorization by capacitors, and the servo feedback circuit ensures stable operation with reliable DC offset.The power supply is designed independently to eliminate mutual interference with the amplifier circuit.In addition, in order to ensure a powerful and spacious power supply capability, it is equipped with a regulator power supply unit far exceeding the current capacity required for music signals.In order to maintain signal purity, all stages are directly connected without wiring.In addition, high-precision parts such as resistors of the US military standard (within ¥1% deviation) are used, and parts are arranged so that maximum efficiency can be obtained through sufficient examination and trial listening.The KRC, which has a particularly complex amplification system, uses a four layer glass-epoxy laminated board, in which audio signals, DC power supply, and two layers of ground are laminated on a single circuit board. This ensures a stable power supply by connecting all elements directly to the power supply in the shortest time. In addition, by connecting each ground point directly to two ground patterns, the influence of the power supply on the audio signal is eliminated and interference noise from other circuits is cut off.Analog source can be supported by built-in special board Phono-B (sold separately).In this board, input sensitivity and impedance can be changed by combination of internal DIP switch, and it is compatible with MC/MM cartridge.A high-quality gold-plated relay is used for the switching of the body, enabling high precision control.The volume control system uses a stepper motor to drive ultra-precision volume.Pure class A operation with high bias is adopted.It comes with a wireless remote control, so you can operate the main body and turn the power amplifier ON/OFF.This remote control has a solid aluminum machined finish."

description:
## Description

"A preamplifier that eliminates complex circuits and faithfully amplifies the input source and feeds it to a power amplifier.The PAM-2has a dual-mono configuration in which two monaural preamplifiers, all of which are completely independent, including not only the circuit but also the level control and input selector, are contained in one chassis.For this reason, the panel is equipped with two monaural level controllers, two input selectors and two tape monitor switches. name: MODEL600
description:
## Description

"This is a stereo power amplifier that is the top-of-the-line of the Kroell full power balance series.Equipped with Sustaine-Plateau Bias II.This circuit is a combination of a predictive sensor circuit that monitors all operational states of the amplifier over a wide range, such as the actual load applied to the output stage, and a bias setting circuit with a unique shift schedule. It realizes an ideal class A operation.The circuit configuration consists of a fully balanced differential circuit for all stages from input to output.The input gain stage amplifier is a current-mode amplifier that operates with the current between the inverting amplifier and the non-inverting amplifier. In addition, the precise gain matching between each amplifier is achieved by means of a unique microcontroller control. This realizes a high-precision balance drive. This cancels the negative influence on the ground line of the amplifier due to the reactive load when the speaker is actually driven, as well as the mutual interference of each stage around the ground line, and ensures excellent drive performance under all conditions.For the KAS (Kroell Audio Standard), which is a reference model of Kroell power amplifier, a metal can-type special product jointly developed with Motorola has been fully adopted.In addition, the fully regulated power stage provides a highly stable power supply from a constant voltage power supply to not only the first stage to the driver stage but also to the output stage. It constantly monitors the drive current and load of the output stage of the amplifier and instantaneously supplies the required voltage according to changes in the current.The Model600uses 14Pc250W class large capacity power transistors.Equipped with a full auto-calibration function, the amplifier automatically optimizes itself by self-evaluating the internal electrical adjustment conditions such as output bias, regulator voltage, and DC offset.On the production line, internal parameters are carefully checked for each unit, and the results are stored in the amplifier. In actual use, all operating conditions, including AC voltage, are monitored as needed to ensure accurate calibration of each unit and proper selection of the plateau level of Sustaine-Plateau Bias II. This feature provides long-term factory performance.In the event of an abnormal situation such as oscillation, DC leak, or short circuit of output terminal, the power supply is cut off immediately. This ensures high safety while eliminating common protective circuits such as relays and fuses, enabling direct connection between output stage and speakers."
